_readme: One entry per mod. The build makes one jar per entry (build/mods/), the mods spreadsheet is made from this file (tools/mods_sheet.py), and 'include' says which code and files go in each jar.

mods.name: Ahrivaea Creatures
mods.summary: Creatures with elemental influences, Fire Emblem-style grid battles in arenas themed after the biome you met them in, and your own levelled-up character.
features: Creatures spawn in the world; their influence (Fire, Frost, Storm ... Arcane) comes from the biome and time of day and sets their look, name and stats

Grid battles seen from above: hit a wild creature with a sword (the only way to start one; they never attack first, and can't be hurt outside battle) and you're taken to your own battle arena built for that biome (25 themes, 15×15 to 27×27, at the world's time of day) to fight it plus 1-4 more; you and 4 of your creatures each move by Speed, then attack, use an item, rally or wait; afterwards you're brought back to safe ground where you were. The arenas can't be visited outside a battle
Counterattacks, high ground, water and lava, influence matchups, crits and dodges (Luck), support (Charisma), fleeing at any time (always works); the enemy side plays itself
Your character levels up to 50 and you spend stat points (/character); your weapon and armor count in battle
Win XP for your creatures and yourself, then recruit creatures you defeated; Vessels and a party of 6
Blockbench creature models with an animated form per influence (the 11 dragons so far)
mods.commands: /party, /party send|release <slot>, /party xp <slot> <amount>, /character, /character spend <stat> <points>; operators: /ahrivaea spawn|givexp|selftest, /battle start|end|recruit, /battle arena <theme>, /battle home, /character givexp
mods.status: Battles playable in biome arenas (placeholder moves until the move list)

mods.name: Ahrivaea Tower Challenges
mods.summary: A ruined tower over every stronghold that the whole server rebuilds by donating items, with leaderboards and rewards.
features: A tower generates above the End portal of all 128 strongholds, in blocks that match its biome
Each tower has its own challenge (what to bring and how much) and its own rewards, harder and richer farther from spawn
Offering chest; the tower rebuilds in 4 stages; fireworks and rewards for the top donors when finished
Per-tower leaderboards; towers can't be broken outside creative mode
Challenges are set in Tower_Challenges.xlsx
mods.players_install: Yes (it's part of the modpack), though it adds no new items or blocks
mods.status: Working (placeholder tower until the real build)

mods.name: Ahrivaea Stellar Gear
mods.summary: Netherite tools and armor upgraded with a nether star into Stellar gear with special powers.
features: Smithing table: nether star + any netherite tool or armor piece = its Stellar version (keeps enchantments)
Pickaxe and shovel mine 3x3; axe fells whole natural trees but never player-placed logs or builds
Hoe tills and harvests-and-replants 3x3; sword heals 20% of the damage it deals
Full Stellar armor set gives flight
Sneak to use the tools one block at a time

mods.name: Ahrivaea Swift Horses
mods.summary: Faster horses, donkeys and mules with their stats on screen, and a way to train them faster still: feed them up three speed tiers, then breed for the top two. Skeleton horses are always top speed.
features: Every horse, donkey, mule, skeleton horse and zombie horse is 1.5x as fast as vanilla (vanilla horses run 5-14 blocks/sec)
Speed tiers 0-5, each multiplying the horse's own speed: x1.5, x1.76, x2.02, x2.28, x2.54, x2.8. The best-bred horses top out near 40 blocks/sec, faster than a Fast Minecart (30)
Tiers 1-3 by feeding a tamed horse: 8 Swift Feed, then 8 Golden Feed, then 4 Racing Feed (crafted from wheat, sugar, apples, golden carrots, golden apples and a rabbit's foot)

Tiers 4-5 only by breeding: a foal takes the better parent's tier, and two parents on the same tier have a 30% chance of a foal one tier higher. Vanilla speed inheritance still applies, so bloodlines matter
Skeleton horses are always at top speed: the best possible bloodline at tier 5 (about 40 blocks/sec), no training needed. Zombie horses can't breed, so they stop at tier 3

See a horse's stats: look at it (up to 16 blocks) for its speed, tier, jump height, health and what its next tier needs; ride it to keep them in the corner with your current speed; they're also beside its inventory screen
mods.commands: /horse (while riding: its stats in chat); operators: /horse settier <0-5>

mods.name: Ahrivaea Fast Minecarts
mods.summary: Minecarts go up to 30 blocks a second (vanilla: 8), on Minecraft's newer minecart physics so they stay on the rails at speed.
features: Top speed 30 blocks/sec on rails, almost 4x vanilla (half that in water; furnace minecarts go half speed)
Turns on Minecraft's newer minecart physics in every world (normally an experiment you pick when making a world): carts follow corners, slopes and loops at any speed instead of flying off
Powered rails get carts up to speed over a longer stretch, so long lines need more of them
mods.players_install: Yes (the client has to move carts the same way)

mods.name: Ahrivaea Woodcutting
mods.summary: The stonecutter cuts wood too: logs into planks, stairs, slabs, fences, doors and more, and into stripped logs, with no crafting grid or sticks.
features: Put any log or wood block in a stonecutter (every wood type, including crimson and warped stems, poplar and bamboo blocks)

One log gives what its 4 planks would make at a crafting table, without needing sticks: 4 planks, 4 stairs, 8 slabs, 2 fences, 1 fence gate, 2 doors, 1 trapdoor, 2 pressure plates, 4 buttons, 2 signs or 8 sticks
Strips logs: log to stripped log, and log or stripped log to (stripped) wood
Planks cut 1:1 like stone: 1 stair, 2 slabs, 1 button or 2 sticks; bamboo planks also make mosaic
Recipes only (no code), made by tools/woodcutting_recipes.py
mods.players_install: No (server only; works for players without the mod)

worlds.name: Ahrivaea (modded world)
worlds.notes: The creature world, reached from the main world by portal
